tagline: High-purity PDRN (Sodium DNA) cosmetic raw material
descriptor: VEO Biotech — a Chinese manufacturer of high-purity Helio PDRN (Sodium DNA) for skin-booster, mesotherapy and cosmetic R&D, with in-house molecular-weight control and per-batch documentation.
about: VEO Biotech is a Chinese manufacturer of high-purity PDRN raw materials, which positions itself as a supply-chain platform in China for mature South Korean PDRN technology. The company states that its team combines PDRN expertise from leading South Korean cosmetics companies with delivery-system research from the Chinese Academy of Sciences ecosystem.

On that basis the company has built two technology platforms — PDRN raw-material preparation and nucleic-acid delivery — and works with both salmon-derived and recombinant sources. Its manufacturing site in Luoyang has a stated annual capacity of high-purity PDRN raw material, with plans to expand it further by 2027.

The company states that its commercial supply is directed to overseas markets, with a large share serving the South Korean cosmetics supply chain and stable deliveries to Korea, Europe and the Americas. Teranova presents VEO Biotech for B2B partners; prices and commercial terms are shared on request, not published.
facts: Official name: ZhengZhou VEO Biotech Co., Limited; manufacturer: Luoyang VEO Biotech Co., Ltd.
High-purity PDRN (Sodium DNA) raw material for cosmetics
Purity ≥99% (HPLC); customizable molecular weight 50–800 kDa, per the company
Brand-stated compliance: ISO 9001 and ISO 22716 GMP; cosmetic standards of South Korea, the USA and the EU (INCI: Sodium DNA)

lines.name: Helio PDRN — Sodium DNA
lines.note: The company's core material: a water-soluble Sodium DNA powder derived from traceable North Pacific wild salmon milt, supplied at ≥99% purity with a molecular weight the company says is customizable within 50–800 kDa and reported per batch.

lines.name: Nucleic-acid delivery
lines.note: A second platform the company describes for delivery of active nucleic acids — nanomicrospheres, liposome encapsulation and penetration-enhancing systems.

tech.name: Purity and molecular-weight control
tech.note: The company states purity of ≥99% by HPLC and molecular weight customizable within 50–800 kDa, with batch-specific results reported separately and a per-batch certificate of analysis.

tech.name: Reported functions of PDRN
tech.note: The company reports that PDRN supports skin regeneration, collagen and elastic-fibre renewal, anti-inflammatory repair, recovery of damaged skin and reduction of UV-related damage. These are the company's own statements, presented as reported and not independently verified by Teranova.

tech.name: Sourcing and documentation
tech.note: Sodium DNA from traceable North Pacific wild salmon milt, described by the company as BSE/TSE-free and antibiotic-free, with a Technical Data Sheet, Safety Data Sheet and a specification summary available for partners.

formats: Sample and bulk grades (10 g · 100 g · 1 kg)
exportNote: The company states that its supply is directed to overseas markets, with a large share serving the South Korean cosmetics supply chain and stable deliveries to Korea, Europe and the Americas. Cooperation is offered on FOB Hong Kong, CIF and DDP terms; there is no exclusive distributor, and the company is open to regional distributors through Teranova. Prices and payment terms are not published and are shared with partners on request.
